docs.title: Rationale
docs.text: This small tool is developed to satisfy the Project structure contract conventions, bootstrapping a new project, generating all the required stuff to meet the requirements.

docs.title: Execution
docs.text:
cwl-cli-archetype \
--clt-id tool_1 \
--clt-id tool_2 \
--clt-id tool_3 \
--target-dir ./a/b/c

The ./a/b/c target dir will be composed as:

$ tree a
a
└── b
    └── c
        ├── cwl-workflow
        │   └── clts.cwl
        ├── tool_1
        │   └── Dockerfile
        ├── tool_2
        │   └── Dockerfile
        └── tool_3
            └── Dockerfile

6 directories, 4 files

The ./a/b/c/cwl-workflow/clts.cwl file will include:

cwlVersion: v1.2

        ramMax: 512
